snippets.title: Avone - Re-render & mở Cart Drawer sau Add to Cart
snippets.description: Lắng nghe teeinblue-event-after-cart-added, gọi /cart/update.js và renderContents của cart-drawer trên theme Avone.

targets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', function () {
  window.forceReloadCartDrawer = function () {
    const cartDrawer = document.querySelector('cart-drawer');
    if (!cartDrawer) return;
    const sectionsToRender = cartDrawer.getSectionsToRender().map(s => s.id);
    fetch(window.routes?.cart_update_url || '/cart/update.js', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/javascript' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ sections: sectionsToRender })
    })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(state => {
      cartDrawer.renderContents(state);
      cartDrawer.open();
    })
    .catch(console.error);
  };
  window.forceReloadCartDrawer();
});
</script>

snippets.title: Corner Stone - Quick Cart Drawer & Cart Icon Header
snippets.description: Cập nhật Quick Cart Drawer và icon cart ở header (cả Desktop & Mobile) sau khi add to cart theme Corner Stone.

targets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', function () {
  fetch(window.location.href)
    .then(response => response.text())
    .then(html => {
      const parser = new DOMParser();
      const doc = parser.parseFromString(html, 'text/html');

      // 1. Cart Drawer (Quick Cart)
      const newDrawer = doc.querySelector('.quick-cart, #quick-cart, [data-quick-cart]');
      const currentDrawer = document.querySelector('.quick-cart, #quick-cart, [data-quick-cart]');
      if (newDrawer && currentDrawer) {
        currentDrawer.innerHTML = newDrawer.innerHTML;
      }

      // 2. Icon Cart on Header (Desktop & Mobile)
      const newCartCount = doc.querySelector('.cart-count, [data-cart-count], .cart-link__bubble');
      const currentCartCount = document.querySelector('.cart-count, [data-cart-count], .cart-link__bubble');
      if (newCartCount && currentCartCount) {
        currentCartCount.innerHTML = newCartCount.innerHTML;
        currentCartCount.classList.remove('hide', 'hidden');
      }

      // Mở Drawer nếu có method
      if (typeof theme !== 'undefined' && theme.cart && typeof theme.cart.open === 'function') {
        theme.cart.open();
      } else if (typeof window.openQuickCart === 'function') {
        window.openQuickCart();
      }
    })
    .catch(error => console.error('Error updating cart:', error));
});
</script>

snippets.title: Eurus - Re-render & mở Cart Drawer sau Add to Cart
snippets.description: Fetch sections cart-drawer & cart-icon-bubble, gọi renderContents và dispatch event mở drawer theme Eurus.

targets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', () => {
  const drawer = document.querySelector('cart-drawer');
  if (drawer) {
    fetch(window.location.pathname + '?sections=cart-drawer,cart-icon-bubble')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(res => {
        drawer.renderContents({ sections: res });
        document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('eurus:cart-drawer:open'));
      });
    if (drawer.classList.contains('is-empty')) drawer.classList.remove('is-empty');
  }
});
</script>

snippets.title: Horizon & Vessel - Deferred Event Promise CartDrawerComponent
snippets.description: Dispatch deferred event promise theo chuẩn CartDrawerComponent của Horizon & Vessel để re-render chính xác.

targets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', function () {
  let resolvePromise;
  const cartPromise = new Promise((resolve) => { resolvePromise = resolve; });
  const event = new CustomEvent('cart-item:add:finished', {
    bubbles: true,
    detail: { cart: cartPromise }
  });
  document.dispatchEvent(event);
  fetch('/cart.js')
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(cartData => { resolvePromise(cartData); })
    .catch(error => console.error('Error fetching cart:', error));
});
</script>

snippets.title: SlideCartHQ - Integration & Cart Refresh
snippets.description: MutationObserver để theo dõi overlay SlideCartHQ và kích hoạt cập nhật giỏ hàng sau khi add to cart.

targets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-component-injected', () => {
  const bodyObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
    const overlay = document.querySelector('#slidecarthq .slidecarthq-overlay');
    if (overlay) {
      bodyObserver.disconnect();
    }
  });
  bodyObserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
});
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', () => {
  if (window.SLIDECART && typeof window.SLIDECART.open === 'function') {
    window.SLIDECART.open();
  }
});
</script>

snippets.title: Concept - Re-render Cart Drawer sau khi Add to Cart
snippets.description: Cập nhật cart-drawer theme Concept sau khi thêm vào giỏ (Gồm Cách 1: PubSub ajaxProduct, Cách 2: Ghi đè method onCartUpdate trong cart.js).

targets.code:
<script>
// ==========================================================
// [CÁCH 1 - Khuyên dùng]: Dùng theme.pubsub và trigger cart:bundled-sections
// ==========================================================
window.tib_custom_cart = window.tib_custom_cart || {};
tib_custom_cart.getSectionInnerHTML = function(html, selector) {
  return new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html').querySelector(selector || '.shopify-section')?.innerHTML;
};
tib_custom_cart.getSectionsToRender = function() {
  return [{ id: 'cart-drawer', section: 'cart-drawer', selector: '.drawer__inner' }];
};
tib_custom_cart.renderContents = function(parsedState) {
  tib_custom_cart.getSectionsToRender().forEach((section) => {
    const sectionElement = section.selector ? document.querySelector(section.selector) : document.getElementById(section.id);
    if (sectionElement) {
      sectionElement.innerHTML = tib_custom_cart.getSectionInnerHTML(parsedState[section.id], section.selector);
    }
  });
};
tib_custom_cart.cartAdded = async function() {
  const cart = document.querySelector('cart-drawer');
  let sectionsToRender = tib_custom_cart.getSectionsToRender().map((section) => section.id).join(',');
  const sections = await fetch('?sections=' + sectionsToRender).then(response => response.json());
  let cartContent = await fetch((window.Shopify?.routes?.root || '/') + 'cart.js').then(response => response.json());
  let sectionsToBundle = [];
  document.documentElement.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cart:bundled-sections', { bubbles: true, detail: { sections: sectionsToBundle } }));
  const cartJson = await (await fetch(window.theme?.routes?.cart_url || '/cart', { ...(window.theme?.utils?.fetchConfig ? window.theme.utils.fetchConfig() : {}) })).json();
  let bundleKey = sectionsToBundle[0];
  if (bundleKey) {
    let sectionKey = bundleKey.split('__')[1];
    cartJson.sections = { [bundleKey]: sections[sectionKey] };
  }
  if (window.theme?.pubsub) {
    theme.pubsub.publish(theme.pubsub.PUB_SUB_EVENTS.cartUpdate, { cart: cartJson });
  }
  document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ajaxProduct:added', { detail: { product: cartJson } }));
  if (cart && typeof cart.show === 'function') { cart.show(); }
};

document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', function() {
  tib_custom_cart.cartAdded();
});

/*
// ==========================================================
// [CÁCH 2 - Dành cho file assets/cart.js phiên bản mới của Concept]:
// Chèn vào method onCartUpdate(event) của theme:
// ==========================================================
const tibSectionId = document.querySelector('cart-drawer');
const sectionToRender = new DOMParser().parseFromString(event.cart.sections[this.sectionId != 'cart-drawer' ? this.sectionId : tibSectionId?.getAttribute('data-section-id')], 'text/html');
const miniCart = document.querySelector(`#MiniCart-${this.sectionId}`) || document.querySelector(`#MiniCart-${tibSectionId?.getAttribute('data-section-id')}`);
if (miniCart) {
  const updatedElement = sectionToRender.querySelector(`#MiniCart-${this.sectionId}`) || sectionToRender.querySelector('#MiniCart-cart-drawer') || sectionToRender.querySelector(`#MiniCart-${tibSectionId?.getAttribute('data-section-id')}`);
  if (updatedElement) { miniCart.innerHTML = updatedElement.innerHTML; }
}
*/
</script>

snippets.title: Universal Cart Drawer Refresh (Tương thích hơn 15 Theme & App)
snippets.description: Hàm cập nhật tổng hợp đa năng: tự động nhận diện API của wetheme, refreshCart, ajaxCart, Monster Cart, SlideCart, UpCart, CartJS, Minimog và Web Components.

targets.code:
<script>
const isFunction = (val) => typeof val === 'function';

const updateDrawerCartsUniversal = (updatedCart) => {
  try {
    if (isFunction(window.wetheme?.updateCartDrawer)) window.wetheme.updateCartDrawer(updatedCart);
    if (isFunction(window.refreshCart)) window.refreshCart(updatedCart);
    if (isFunction(window.ajaxCart?.load)) window.ajaxCart.load();
    if (isFunction(window.monster_setCartItems) && updatedCart?.items?.length) window.monster_setCartItems(updatedCart.items);
    if (isFunction(window.updateCartDrawerUI)) window.updateCartDrawerUI();
    if (isFunction(window.cart?.updateCart)) {
      window.cart.updateCart();
      if (isFunction(window.cart?.toggleCartDropdown)) window.cart.toggleCartDropdown();
    }
    if (isFunction(window.SLIDECART_UPDATE)) window.SLIDECART_UPDATE();
    if (isFunction(window.HS_SLIDE_CART_UPDATE)) window.HS_SLIDE_CART_UPDATE();
    if (isFunction(window.upcartRegisterAddToCart)) window.upcartRegisterAddToCart();
    if (isFunction(window.CartJS?.cart?.update)) window.CartJS.cart.update(updatedCart);
    if (isFunction(window.monster_refresh)) window.monster_refresh();
    if (isFunction(window.MinimogTheme?.Cart?.renderNewCart)) window.MinimogTheme.Cart.renderNewCart();
    if (isFunction(window.theme?.miniCart?.updateElements)) {
      window.theme.miniCart.updateElements();
      if (isFunction(window.theme?.miniCart?.generateCart)) window.theme.miniCart.generateCart();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Universal cart window method update failed:', e);
  }

  // Trigger các custom event phổ biến
  try {
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cart:build'));
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cartdrawer:refresh'));
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dispatch:cart-drawer:refresh'));
    document.documentElement.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cart:refresh', { bubbles: true }));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Universal cart custom event failed:', e);
  }
};

document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', async function() {
  try {
    const updatedCart = await (await fetch('/cart.js')).json();
    updateDrawerCartsUniversal(updatedCart);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error fetching cart:', err);
  }
});
</script>

snippets.title: Xboost Cart Drawer Upsell - Thay thumbnail sản phẩm
snippets.description: Lắng nghe sự kiện xboost-open-cart của app Xboost và tự động cập nhật ảnh customization_image trong giỏ hàng.

targets.code:
<script>
window.addEventListener('xboost-open-cart', function () {
  setTimeout(function() {
    fetch('/cart.js')
      .then(response => response.json())
      .then(data => {
        data.items.forEach((item, index) => {
          if (item.properties && item.properties.customization_image) {
            const itemElement = document.querySelectorAll('.xb-cart-item')[index];
            if (itemElement) {
              const imageElement = itemElement.querySelector('img');
              if (imageElement) imageElement.src = item.properties.customization_image;
            }
          }
        });
      });
  }, 1000);
});
</script>

snippets.title: Monster Cart Upsell - Cập nhật thumbnail giỏ hàng
snippets.description: Tự động thay đổi hình ảnh trong cart drawer của app Monster Upsell bằng đường link customization của Teeinblue.

targets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  function updateMonsterCartImages() {
    fetch('/cart.js')
      .then(response => response.json())
      .then(data => {
        const cartImages = document.querySelectorAll('.monster-cart-item img');
        data.items.forEach((item, index) => {
          if (item.properties && item.properties.customization_image && cartImages[index]) {
            cartImages[index].src = item.properties.customization_image;
          }
        });
      });
  }
  document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', function() {
    setTimeout(updateMonsterCartImages, 800);
  });
});
</script>

snippets.title: AOV Cart Drawer - Tích hợp thumbnail & trigger mở giỏ
snippets.description: Lắng nghe sự kiện thêm vào giỏ và tự động thay thế ảnh customization cho app AOV Cart Drawer.

targets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('teeinblue-event-after-cart-added', function () {
  setTimeout(() => {
    fetch('/cart.js')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(cart => {
        cart.items.forEach((item, idx) => {
          if (item.properties?._customization_image || item.properties?.customization_image) {
            const imgUrl = item.properties._customization_image || item.properties.customization_image;
            const itemRows = document.querySelectorAll('.aov-cart-item');
            if (itemRows[idx]) {
              const img = itemRows[idx].querySelector('img');
              if (img) img.src = imgUrl;
            }
          }
        });
      });
  }, 1000);
});
</script>
